why: Neither note has a factual, number or page error. B adds the [23]/[30] citation inconsistency, makes clear the NDCG headline comes from human review, and lists more undisclosed details. A's extra points are minor.

only_here: Manual evaluation does not report how many queries were annotated or the annotation protocol
A/B test does not report business metrics beyond gross revenue
RocketQA linked as the source of cross-batch sampling and of cross-encoder denoising of mined negatives
Paper's inconsistency: cross-batch sampling is cited as [23] on p.1 but as [30] on p.2
Headline +7.34% NDCG@5 comes from the human review, not from the A/B test
Only relative lifts are reported, no absolute metric values
Number of mining iterations and the token-overlap rules are not disclosed
No ablation of warm-start on its own
